title: How Many (Half) Moons? Measuring Technology Adoption, From the Sky and on the Ground

title: Economic Development and the Environment
venue: Handbook of Development Economics, Dupas, Goldberg and Pande
abstract: Economic development relies on and transforms the environment. The transformation is evident in the poor environmental quality in many developing countries. For example, air quality in Southeast Asia is three times worse than in the United States, in sub-Saharan Africa four times worse and in South Asia more than six times worse. We model how environmental quality affects health, productivity and well-being and how individuals privately adapt to environmental hazards. We also model how collective action and formal regulation contribute to environmental quality. We draw three main findings from a review of empirical research on these mechanisms. First, individual adaptation to environmental hazards is both inadequate as a remedy and inefficiently low. Second, collective action, without the state, to manage resources or address externalities has been outstripped by the scale of environmental problems. Third, state action through formal regulation works better than it looks. Many formal regulations are coarse, poorly targeted and inefficient, but nonetheless yield benefits in excess of their costs. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 经济发展依赖于环境，也会改变环境。这种改变在许多发展中国家的环境质量低下中表现得十分明显。例如，东南亚的空气质量比美国差三倍，撒哈拉以南非洲差四倍，南亚则差六倍以上。我们构建模型，分析环境质量如何影响健康、生产率和福祉，以及个人如何私下适应环境危害。我们还构建模型，分析集体行动和正式监管如何促进环境质量改善。通过对这些机制的实证研究进行回顾，我们得出三点主要发现。第一，个人对环境危害的适应既是一种不充分的补救手段，也是低效率的。第二，在缺乏国家介入的情况下，依靠集体行动来管理资源或应对外部性，已经赶不上环境问题的规模。第三，通过正式监管进行的国家行动，效果好于表面看起来的样子。许多正式监管措施粗放、针对性差且效率低下，但其所带来的收益仍超过成本。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org上免费下载本文。

Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Hunger

Dodging Day Zero: Drought, Adaptation, and Inequality in Cape Town
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association, jvaf
abstract: A near-catastrophic drought in Cape Town, South Africa illustrates three general implications of climate change for publicly-provided utility services. First, to reduce aggregate water demand, the public utility increased prices, leading to large demand reductions by richer households. Prior to the drought they use twice the public piped water of poorer households. At the peak of the drought, they use less. Second, some of the differential demand reduction comes from richer households substituting away from public water toward privately financed groundwater. This private adaptation both lowers the public utility's total revenue and shifts costs onto poorer households, consequences that persist after the drought abates. Third, policy interventions mitigate some of the fiscal and distributional impacts of private adaptation. These findings highlight how climate adaptation, in the context of publicly provided goods and services, can create pecuniary and environmental externalities with equity consequences. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 南非开普敦发生的一场近乎灾难性的干旱，说明了气候变化对公共提供的公用事业服务的三点普遍影响。第一，为减少总体水需求，公用事业公司提高了水价，导致较富裕家庭的用水量大幅下降。干旱之前，他们使用的公共管道水是贫困家庭的两倍。在干旱最严重时，他们的用水量反而低于贫困家庭。第二，富裕家庭用水需求的差异化下降，部分源于他们转而用私人出资的地下水替代公共水源。这种私人适应既降低了公用事业公司的总收入，又将成本转嫁给贫困家庭，且这些后果在干旱结束后依然持续。第三，政策干预能够减轻私人适应所带来的部分财政和分配影响。这些发现凸显了在公共提供商品和服务的背景下，气候适应可能产生的金钱外部性和环境外部性，并带来公平性后果。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org上免费下载本文。

title: Harvesting the rain: The adoption of environmental technologies in the Sahel
abstract: Many agricultural and environmental technologies require large upfront investments in exchange for longer-term benefits. This time profile of costs and benefits makes adoption particularly sensitive to liquidity and credit constraints, which are prevalent in low-income settings. We test the importance of these barriers to the adoption of an agricultural technique that helps reduce land degradation and restore soil fertility in Niger. We find little evidence that liquidity or credit constraints deter adoption: instead, providing farmers with training increases the share of adopters by over 90 percentage points, whereas adding conditional or unconditional cash transfers has no additional effect. Adoption increases agricultural output, reduces land turnover and leads to adoption spillovers up to three years after treatment. These results imply that training can be a cost-effective and scalable means of promoting the adoption of profitable technologies.
abstract_zh: 许多农业和环境技术需要大量前期投资，才能换取长期收益。这种成本与收益的时间分布，使得采纳行为对流动性和信贷约束特别敏感，而这类约束在低收入地区十分普遍。我们检验了这些障碍对尼日尔一项农业技术采纳的影响，该技术有助于减轻土地退化并恢复土壤肥力。我们发现，流动性或信贷约束阻碍采纳的证据很少：相反，为农户提供培训使采纳者比例提高了90多个百分点，而增加有条件或无条件的现金转移则没有额外效果。采纳行为提高了农业产出，减少了土地流转，并且在干预后长达三年内产生了采纳溢出效应。这些结果表明，培训可能是促进采纳有利可图技术的一种具有成本效益且可推广的手段。

title: Money (not) to burn: Payments for ecosystem services to reduce crop residue burning
abstract: We test whether payments for ecosystem services (PES) can curb the highly polluting practice of crop residue burning in India. Standard PES contracts pay participants after verification that they met a proenvironment condition (clearing fields without burning). We randomize paying a portion of the money up front and unconditionally to address liquidity constraints and farmer distrust, which may undermine the standard contract’s effectiveness. Incorporating partial up-front payment into the contract increases compliance by 10 percentage points, which is corroborated by satellite-based burning measurements. The cost per life saved is $3,600–$5,400. The standard PES contract has no effect on burning. (JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们检验生态系统服务付费（PES）能否遏制印度高污染的秸秆焚烧行为。标准的生态系统服务付费合约，是在核实参与者满足了环保条件（即不焚烧即清理田地）之后才支付报酬。我们随机安排部分款项提前、无条件支付，以应对流动性约束和农户的不信任问题，因为这些问题可能会削弱标准合约的效果。将部分提前支付纳入合约，使合规率提高了10个百分点，卫星遥感测得的焚烧数据也证实了这一结果。每挽救一条生命的成本为3600至5400美元。标准的生态系统服务付费合约对焚烧行为没有任何影响。（JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58）

title: Adaptation to Climate Change
venue: Handbook of the Economics of Climate Change, Barrage and Hsiang
abstract: Mounting costs of anthropogenic climate change reveal that adaptation will be essential to human well-being in coming decades. At the same time, the literature on the economics of adaptation offers relatively little guidance for emerging policy. In this chapter, we review the existing literature, focusing on how it can better inform adaptation policy design and implementation.A simple conceptual model of adaptation decision-making describes two core adaptation channels that we link to two streams of adaptation literature, which have emerged largely in parallel. We outline how insights from these literatures can be used for adaptation policy evaluation, highlight key limitations of and opportunities for public intervention in private adaptation markets, and provide guidance for future work.
abstract_zh: 人为气候变化的代价日益攀升，表明在未来几十年里，适应将对人类福祉至关重要。与此同时，关于适应经济学的文献对新兴政策的指导作用相对有限。在本章中，我们回顾现有文献，重点探讨如何更好地为适应政策的设计与实施提供依据。一个简单的适应决策概念模型描述了两大核心适应渠道，我们将其与两条基本上平行发展的适应文献分别相联系。我们阐述了如何利用这些文献的见解进行适应政策评估，指出私人适应市场中公共干预的主要局限与机遇，并为未来研究提供指导。

Charging ahead: Prepaid electricity metering in South Africa
abstract: The standard approach to recovering the cost of electricity provision is to bill customers monthly for past consumption. If unable to pay, customers face disconnection, the utility loses revenue, and the service provision model is undermined.A possible solution to this problem is prepaid metering, in which customers buy electricity upfront and use it until the prepaid amount is consumed. We use data from Cape Town, South Africa to examine the effects of prepaid electricity metering on residential consumption and returns to the electric utility. Over 4,000 customers on monthly billing were involuntarily assigned to receive a prepaid electricity meter, with exogenous variation in the timing of the meter replacement. Electricity use falls by about 13 percent as a result of the switch, a decrease that persists for the following year. This creates a tradeoff for the utility: revenue from consumption falls but more of it is recovered on time and at a lower cost. The benefits to the electric utility outweigh the costs, on average, though results are very heterogeneous. Poorer customers and those with a history of delinquent payment behavior show the greatest improvement in profitability when switched to a prepaid meter. These findings point to an important role for metering technologies in expanding energy access for the poor.
abstract_zh: 回收电力供应成本的标准做法，是每月对客户过去的用电量进行收费。若客户无力支付，将面临断电，公用事业公司随之损失收入，服务的提供模式也就难以维系。预付费电表是解决这一问题的一种可能方案，即客户预先购买电量，直至预付额度用完为止。我们利用南非开普敦的数据，考察预付费电表对居民用电量及电力公司收益的影响。超过4000名原本按月计费的客户被强制安装预付费电表，电表更换的时间具有外生变异。转为预付费后，用电量下降约13%，且这一降幅在次年仍然持续。这给电力公司带来了一种权衡：来自用电的收入减少，但更多的费用得以按时、以较低成本收回。总体而言，电力公司的收益超过成本，不过不同客户的结果差异很大。较贫困的客户，以及有过拖欠缴费历史的客户，在改用预付费电表后，盈利能力改善最为显著。这些发现表明，计量技术在扩大贫困人口的能源可及性方面可以发挥重要作用。

title: City of Cape Town, South Africa: Aligning Internal Data Capabilities with External Research Partnerships
Seasonal liquidity, rural labor markets and agricultural production
abstract: Rural economies in many developing countries are characterized by a lean season in the months preceding harvest, when farmers have depleted their cash and grain savings from the previous year. To identify the impacts of liquidity during the lean season, we offered subsidized loans in randomly selected villages in rural Zambia. Ninety-eight percent of households took up the loan. Loan eligibility led to increases in on-farm labor and agricultural output, driving up wages in local labor markets. Larger effects for poorer households suggest that liquidity constraints contribute to inequality in rural economies. (JEL O13, O15, O18, Q11, Q12, R23)
abstract_zh: 许多发展中国家的农村经济，都具有收获前数月的“青黄不接”季节特征：在此期间，农户此前一年积累的现金和粮食储备已经耗尽。为识别青黄不接期流动性的影响，我们在赞比亚农村的随机选定村庄提供了补贴贷款。98%的家庭选择了贷款。获得贷款资格后，农场劳动投入和农业产出均有所增加，并推高了当地劳动力市场的工资。对较贫困家庭的效应更为显著，这表明流动性约束加剧了农村经济中的不平等。（JEL O13, O15, O18, Q11, Q12, R23）

title: Self-selection into payments for ecosystem services programs
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Designers and funders of payments for ecosystem services (PES) programs have long worried that payments flow to landholders who would have conserved forests even without the program, undermining the environmental benefits (“additionality”) and cost-effectiveness of PES. If landholders self-select into PES programs based on how much conservation they were going to undertake anyway, then those who were planning to conserve should always enroll. This paper discusses the less-appreciated fact that enrollment is often based on other factors too. The hassle of signing up or financial costs of enrollment (e.g., purchasing seedlings) can affect who participates in a PES program. These enrollment costs reduce overall take-up, and, importantly, they can also influence the composition of landholders who select into the program—and thereby the program’s environmental benefits per enrollee. Enrollment costs can increase a program’s benefits per enrollee if they are systematically higher for (and thus deter enrollment by) landholders who would have conserved anyway. Alternatively, enrollment costs can dampen per-enrollee benefits if their correlation with status-quo conservation is in the opposite direction. We illustrate these points with evidence from two studies of randomized trials of PES programs aimed at increasing forest cover in Uganda and Malawi. We also discuss how in other sectors, such as social welfare, policy designers have purposefully adjusted the costs of program enrollment to influence the composition of participants and improve cost-effectiveness. We propose that these ideas for targeting could be incorporated into the design of PES programs.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务付费（PES）项目的设计者和资助者长期以来担心，付费会流向那些即使没有该项目也会保护森林的土地所有者，从而削弱环境效益（“额外性”）和PES的成本效益。如果土地所有者根据其原本就会进行的保护程度进行自我选择，那么原本打算保护的人应当始终会参加项目。本文讨论了一个较少受到重视的事实：参与与否往往还取决于其他因素。报名的麻烦或登记的财务成本（例如购买树苗）会影响谁参与PES项目。这些参与成本会降低总体参与率，而且重要的是，它们还会影响选择加入项目的土地所有者构成，从而影响每位参与者所带来的环境效益。如果参与成本系统性地更高，从而阻碍了那些原本就会进行保护的土地所有者参与，那么参与成本可以提高项目每位参与者的效益。反之，如果参与成本与现状保护行为的相关方向相反，参与成本则可能削弱每位参与者的效益。我们以两项针对乌干达和马拉维森林覆盖率提升而开展的PES随机试验研究为证据，说明上述观点。我们还讨论了在社会福利等其他领域，政策设计者如何有意调整项目参与成本，以影响参与者构成并提高成本效益。我们认为，这些目标瞄准的思路可以被纳入PES项目的设计之中。

title: Private information and the allocation of land use subsidies in Malawi
abstract: Efficient targeting of public programs is difficult when the cost or benefit to potential recipients is private information. This study illustrates the potential of self-selection to improve allocational outcomes in the context of a program that subsidizes tree planting in Malawi. Landholders who received a tree planting contract as a result of bidding in an auction kept significantly more trees alive over a three year period than did landholders who received the contract through a lottery. The gains from targeting on private information through the auction represent a 30 percent cost savings per surviving tree for the implementing organization. (JEL D04, D44, D82, O13, Q24, Q28)
abstract_zh: 当潜在受益者的成本或收益属于私人信息时，公共项目的有效瞄准十分困难。本研究以马拉维一项补贴植树的项目为例，说明自我选择在改善资源配置结果方面的潜力。通过拍卖投标获得植树合同的土地所有者，在三年期间存活的树木明显多于通过抽签获得合同的土地所有者。通过拍卖利用私人信息进行瞄准，使实施机构每棵存活树木的成本节约了30%。（JEL D04, D44, D82, O13, Q24, Q28）

title: Market inefficiencies and the adoption of agricultural technologies in developing countries
venue: White paper prepared for the Agricultural Technology Adoption Initiative, JPAL (MIT) / CEGA (Berkeley)
abstract: This paper summarizes selected research on market inefficiencies that constrain agricultural technology adoption and how these inefficiencies can be overcome. In developing country settings, agricultural technologies that would be profitable in an ideal world without market inefficiencies may go unadopted because of associated market failures, such as lack of access to credit or insecure property rights. The review organizes these barriers to adoption into seven categories and analyzes what we do and do not know about strategies to overcome these barriers. In analyzing this question, the review draws upon relevant findings from agricultural and non-agricultural studies in economics and related disciplines. Particular attention is given to studies that generate rigorous causal evidence, and areas lacking such evidence are noted.
abstract_zh: 本文总结了部分关于市场低效如何制约农业技术采用、以及如何克服这些低效的研究。在发展中国家，那些在不存在市场低效的理想世界中本可盈利的农业技术，可能因相关的市场失灵（如缺乏信贷渠道或产权不稳定）而未被采用。本综述将这些采用障碍归纳为七类，并分析了我们对于克服这些障碍的策略已知与未知之处。在分析这一问题时，本综述借鉴了经济学及相关学科中农业研究与非农业研究的相关发现。综述特别关注那些提供了严谨因果证据的研究，并指出了缺乏此类证据的领域。

title: Auction design for the private provision of public goods in developing countries: Lessons from payments for environmental services in Malawi and Indonesia
A revealed preference approach to estimating supply curves for ecosystem services: Experimental field auctions and soil erosion control in Indonesia
Designing payments for ecosystem services: Lessons from previous experience with incentive-based mechanisms
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Payments for ecosystem services (PES) policies compensate individuals or communities for undertaking actions that increase the provision of ecosystem services such as water purification, flood mitigation, or carbon sequestration. PES schemes rely on incentives to induce behavioral change and can thus be considered part of the broader class of incentive- or market-based mechanisms for environmental policy. By recognizing that PES programs are incentive-based, policymakers can draw on insights from the substantial body of accumulated knowledge about this class of instruments. In particular, this article offers a set of lessons about how the environmental, socioeconomic, political, and dynamic context of a PES policy is likely to interact with policy design to produce policy outcomes, including environmental effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, and poverty alleviation.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务付费（PES）政策向那些采取行动以增加生态系统服务供给的个人或社区提供补偿，这些服务包括水质净化、洪水缓解或碳汇等。PES机制依靠激励来诱导行为改变，因此可以被视为更广泛的环境政策激励型或市场型机制的一部分。认识到PES项目属于激励型机制，政策制定者便可借鉴关于这一类工具的大量既有知识积累。特别地，本文就PES政策的环境、社会经济、政治和动态背景如何与政策设计相互作用，进而产生政策结果（包括环境有效性、成本效益和减贫效果）提出了一系列经验教训。
